descripcion.en: At A2 you tell past events with the past simple, and introduce the past continuous for a background action interrupted by another: I was walking when it rained. This is the first step towards telling a full story.
descripcion.de: Auf A2 erzählst du vergangene Ereignisse mit dem Simple Past und führst das Past Continuous für eine Hintergrundhandlung ein, die von einer anderen unterbrochen wird: I was walking when it rained. Das ist der erste Schritt hin zum Erzählen einer vollständigen Geschichte.
descripcion.es: En A2 cuentas hechos pasados con el pasado simple e introduces el pasado continuo para una acción de fondo interrumpida por otra: I was walking when it rained. Es el primer paso para contar una historia completa.
descripcion.fr: Au niveau A2, tu racontes des événements passés avec le prétérit et tu introduis le prétérit continu pour une action d’arrière-plan interrompue par une autre : I was walking when it rained. C’est la première étape vers le récit d’une histoire complète.
descripcion.it: A livello A2 racconti eventi passati con il past simple e introduci il past continuous per un’azione di sfondo interrotta da un’altra: I was walking when it rained. È il primo passo verso il racconto di una storia completa.
descripcion.pt: No nível A2, você conta acontecimentos passados com o simple past e introduz o past continuous para uma ação de fundo interrompida por outra: I was walking when it rained. Esse é o primeiro passo para contar uma história completa.

filas.en: I was walking when it started to rain.
filas.de: Ich war gerade zu Fuß unterwegs, als es anfing zu regnen.
filas.es: Iba caminando cuando empezó a llover.
filas.fr: Je marchais quand il s’est mis à pleuvoir.
filas.it: Stavo camminando quando ha iniziato a piovere.
filas.pt: Eu estava caminhando quando começou a chover.

filas.en: I lived there for two years.
filas.de: Ich habe dort zwei Jahre lang gelebt.
filas.fr: J’y ai vécu pendant deux ans.
filas.it: Ho vissuto lì per due anni.

texto.de: Ich habe sie gestern Nachmittag angerufen.
texto.es: La llamé ayer por la tarde.
texto.pt: Liguei para ela ontem à tarde.

texto.en: I was walking home when it started to rain.
texto.de: Ich war auf dem Heimweg, als es anfing zu regnen.
texto.es: Iba caminando a casa cuando empezó a llover.
texto.fr: Je rentrais chez moi à pied quand il s’est mis à pleuvoir.
texto.it: Stavo tornando a casa a piedi quando ha iniziato a piovere.
texto.pt: Eu estava voltando para casa a pé quando começou a chover.

texto.en: I lived in Madrid for two years.
texto.de: Ich habe zwei Jahre lang in Madrid gelebt.
texto.es: Viví en Madrid durante dos años.
texto.fr: J’ai vécu à Madrid pendant deux ans.
texto.it: Ho vissuto a Madrid per due anni.
texto.pt: Morei em Madri por dois anos.

notas.de: Das Past Continuous wird mit was/were + -ing gebildet.
notas.es: El pasado continuo se forma con was/were + -ing.
notas.fr: Le prétérit continu se forme avec was/were + -ing.
notas.it: Il past continuous si forma con was/were + -ing.
notas.pt: O past continuous é formado com was/were + -ing.

notas.en: When usually introduces the interrupting event, in the past simple.
notas.de: When leitet gewöhnlich das unterbrechende Ereignis im Simple Past ein.
notas.es: When suele introducir el hecho que interrumpe, en pasado simple.
notas.fr: When introduit généralement l’événement qui interrompt, au prétérit.
notas.it: When introduce di solito l’evento che interrompe, al past simple.
notas.pt: When normalmente introduz o evento que interrompe, no simple past.

notas.en: Most past stories only need the past simple; the past continuous adds background.
notas.de: Die meisten Geschichten in der Vergangenheit brauchen nur das Simple Past; das Past Continuous fügt Hintergrund hinzu.
notas.es: La mayoría de las historias en pasado solo necesitan el pasado simple; el pasado continuo añade el contexto de fondo.
notas.fr: La plupart des récits au passé n’ont besoin que du prétérit ; le prétérit continu ajoute l’arrière-plan.
notas.it: La maggior parte dei racconti al passato ha bisogno solo del past simple; il past continuous aggiunge lo sfondo.
notas.pt: A maioria das histórias no passado só precisa do simple past; o past continuous acrescenta o pano de fundo.

contraste.es: Spanish uses the imperfecto for the background and the indefinido for the main event, with a logic very close to English.
contraste.de: German uses the same past form for the background and the main event (Ich ging nach Hause, als es anfing zu regnen). German speakers therefore rarely use the past continuous and need to practise it for the background: I was walking home when it started to rain.
contraste.it: Italian stavo camminando corresponds exactly to I was walking, and the passato prossimo to the main event. The logic transfers well: I was walking home when it started to rain.
contraste.fr: The French imparfait (je marchais quand il a commencé à pleuvoir) corresponds well to the past continuous for the background. The logic transfers well: I was walking when it started to rain.
contraste.pt: Portuguese estava a andar or estava andando corresponds exactly to I was walking, and the simple past to the main event. The logic transfers well: I was walking home when it started to rain.

errores.en: Using the past simple for the background action.
errores.de: Das Simple Past für die Hintergrundhandlung verwenden.
errores.es: Usar el pasado simple para la acción de fondo.
errores.fr: Utiliser le prétérit pour l’action d’arrière-plan.
errores.it: Usare il past simple per l’azione di sfondo.
errores.pt: Usar o simple past para a ação de fundo.

autochequeo.en: Is the main event in the past simple?
autochequeo.de: Steht das Hauptereignis im Simple Past?
autochequeo.es: ¿El acontecimiento principal está en pasado simple?
autochequeo.it: L’evento principale è al past simple?
autochequeo.pt: O evento principal está no simple past?

autochequeo.en: Have I used both tenses at least once?
autochequeo.de: Habe ich beide Zeitformen mindestens einmal verwendet?
autochequeo.es: ¿He usado ambos tiempos al menos una vez?
autochequeo.fr: Ai-je utilisé les deux temps au moins une fois ?
autochequeo.it: Ho usato entrambi i tempi almeno una volta?
autochequeo.pt: Usei os dois tempos pelo menos uma vez?

promptCorreccion.en: Focus only on the past simple and the past continuous. Check the form of was/were plus -ing. Do not rewrite the text. Check whether the story sounds like a real sequence of events.
promptCorreccion.de: Achte nur auf Simple Past und Past Continuous. Prüfe die Form was/were + -ing. Formuliere den Text nicht neu. Prüfe, ob die Geschichte wie eine echte Abfolge von Ereignissen klingt.
promptCorreccion.es: Concéntrate solo en el pasado simple y el pasado continuo. Comprueba la forma was/were + -ing. No reescribas el texto. Comprueba si la historia suena como una secuencia real de acontecimientos.
promptCorreccion.fr: Concentre-toi uniquement sur le prétérit et le prétérit continu. Vérifie la forme was/were + -ing. Ne réécris pas le texte. Vérifie si l’histoire ressemble à une véritable suite d’événements.
promptCorreccion.it: Concentrati solo sul past simple e sul past continuous. Controlla la forma was/were + -ing. Non riscrivere il testo. Verifica se la storia suona come una vera sequenza di eventi.
promptCorreccion.pt: Concentre-se apenas no simple past e no past continuous. Verifique a forma was/were + -ing. Não reescreva o texto. Confira se a história soa como uma sequência real de acontecimentos.

es: Mapping the imperfect onto the past simple: *When I arrived, he slept* from *él dormía* instead of *he was sleeping*.
de: Using the present perfect for the background action, from the Perfekt: *I have read when he called* instead of *I was reading*.
it: Mapping the imperfect onto the past simple: *When I arrived, he slept* from *lui dormiva* instead of *he was sleeping*.
fr: Mapping the imperfect onto the past simple: *When I arrived, he slept* from *il dormait* instead of *he was sleeping*.
pt: Mapping the imperfect onto the past simple: *When I arrived, he slept* from *ele dormia* instead of *he was sleeping*.
